column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Gomorrah, Belphe, and the Eviction
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: The people in this city sure speak as if they cannot make up their minds!
Indeed, its residents seem to have no vitality for living!
That is not true!
Only those slackers are bad; this is a good city!
(Oh... what a pretty lady!)
What is wrong, miss? Why are you crying?
Are you travelers...? No, it is nothing...
Tears do not suit a smile!
Of course tears do not suit a smile, idiot!!
Nyaah! The bugs in your head are crawling out your ears!
Are you... really in your right mind saying that?!
No, it really is nothing...
It is just that the home I lived in was destroyed to make a park...
That is absolutely something!!
Is it because she has white $$羽$$?!
That is awful.
The color of one's $$羽$$ has nothing to do with it. It was decided by the city.
The city? Who do you mean by that?
The city... I mean...
I feel sorry for you, but that remark is not commendable.
Huh?! Ah! Lord $$ベルフェ$$, the $$領主$$!!
If you alone endure it, the people of the city can share a comfortable space!
Besides, you have surely been given a room in an equally apportioned communal residence.
But my dead mother's grave and so many memories are here...!
Your statement plainly reveals an intention to complain against the city!
In accordance with the city's code, you will accompany us Grievance Inspectors!
Hey, hey, what is going on?!
For now, please come to this city's $$領主$$ residence.
We can speak there...
